name: יְרִיאֵל
gloss: God teaches; or God has laid (founded)
summary: A son of Tola son of Issachar, a head of his father's house, among the mighty men of valour counted in David's days (1Ch 7:2). The name is יְרִי- as in Jeriah, with אֵל: “God teaches” (the hiphil, as in Job 36:22, “who is a teacher like him?”) or “God has laid” (the qal, Job 38:6). Scripture does not say which.

evidence.note: “The sons of Tola: Uzzi, Rephaiah, וִירִיאֵל, Jahmai, Ibsam and Shemuel, heads of their fathers' houses.”

note: Takes j.di.ai (1 token). The same first element as יְרִיָּהוּ (names/jeriah.json); the readings are of the root only.
